|note_res_ELGS=Since the winners of the [[2016–17 Coupe de France]] and the [[2016–17 Coupe de la Ligue]], [[Paris Saint-Germain FC|Paris Saint-Germain]], qualified for European competition based on league position, the spot awarded to the Coupe de France winners ([[2017–18 UEFA Europa League#Group stage|Europa League group stage]]) was passed to the fourth-placed team and the spot awarded to the Coupe de la Ligue winners ([[2017–18 UEFA Europa League#Third qualifying round|Europa League third qualifying round]]) was passed to the sixth-placed team. The fifth-placed team received the spot in Europa League third qualifying round originally designated to the fourth-placed team. |note_res_EL3Q=ELGS

|note_res_REN=After being relegated to Ligue 2, Bastia was initially further relegated to National due to financial difficulties.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://sport24.lefigaro.fr/football/ligue-2/actualites/fin-d-un-long-feuilleton-bastia-en-national-1-et-le-paris-fc-repeche-en-l2-869704|title=FIN D'UN LONG FEUILLETON, BASTIA EN NATIONAL 1 ET LE PARIS FC REPÊCHÉ EN L2|language=French}}</ref> On 10 August 2017, the FFF announced that Bastia was denied entry to National. The club therefore took the place of its reserve team in Championnat National 3.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.eurosport.fr/football/ligue-2/2017-2018/le-groupe-de-repreneurs-jette-l-eponge-bastia-evoluera-en-national-3_sto6283958/story.shtml|title=Le groupe de repreneurs jette l'éponge, Bastia évoluera en National 3|publisher=eurosport.fr|language=fr|date=10 August 2017}}</ref>
